messages.subject: [adegenet-forum] new patches for adegenet
messages.body_plain:
Dear users,

I have just commited four patches to the current version of adegenet (1.2-3) on adegenet's website:
http://adegenet.r-forge.r-project.org/      (section download)
They should be available within a few hours, the time for R-Forge to update to page. As some of them correct bugs, I recommend you have a swift look in case they fix a function you would be using. 

Although usually the lifespan of patches is rather short, the next adegenet release may be delayed as it will incorporate a new method, which is still under review.

Best regards,

Thibaut.
--

messages.subject: [adegenet-forum] input data
messages.body_plain:
I have a genetic dataset derived from genepop software with one line per
individual
and 2xL columns... i.e. alleles are coded as integer within each cell.
Instead, the geneind object would require all alleles as columns... Is there
an automatic conversion function?

Thanks
Duccio
